name: Monarchic Public Website
description: Content and composition contract for the public Monarchic marketing, product, research, and waitlist website.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Introduce Monarchic as autonomous engineering as a service while making the current MCP catalog and proof-backed direction clear.

sections.purpose: Show the autonomous engineering platform vision and identify the MCP catalog as the first commercial surface.
layoutGuidance: Align the hero block and platform direction panel in the first viewport.

sections.purpose: Demonstrate product capability with ExplicitMem quality and hosted route latency proof.
layoutGuidance: Keep ExplicitMem quality metrics separate from hosted staging MCP latency.

sections.purpose: Preview the MCP catalog and connect each primary product to a deeper product page.
layoutGuidance: Feature ExplicitMem, RepoIntel, and BrowserOps without hiding the larger Monarchic platform direction.

sections.purpose: Capture demand for gated product access.
layoutGuidance: The join waitlist interaction must visibly submit or show an error.

pages.title: Products
pages.purpose: Let buyers compare available MCPs, bundles, coming-soon plans, and the future Monarchic AI platform.
forbiddenContent: prices not present in the synchronized product catalog

sections.purpose: Explain that the MCP catalog is live directionally while access remains gated.
layoutGuidance: Use catalog-specific copy, not the homepage headline repeated verbatim.

sections.purpose: Display bundles, individual MCPs, and coming-soon products with clear buyer fit.
layoutGuidance: Avoid products/research tab swapping; use direct page links instead.

sections.purpose: Route non-purchasable product demand to waitlist capture while available Stripe-backed products retain clear pricing.
layoutGuidance: Make access state and waitlist action visible before the page ends.

pages.title: ExplicitMem Product
pages.purpose: Position ExplicitMem as the strongest memory product and connect buyer needs to benchmark evidence.

sections.purpose: Explain ExplicitMem capability, buyer fit, and current availability.
layoutGuidance: Make durable memory and receipt-backed retrieval the first product signal.

sections.purpose: Show local benchmark quality and hosted staging route latency with boundaries.

pages.title: Research
pages.purpose: Index benchmark notes and receipts for the MCP products without overstating scope.

sections.purpose: Frame Monarchic research as proof for production agent tools.
layoutGuidance: Use research-specific language and keep product links close.

sections.purpose: Show ExplicitMem, RepoIntel, and BrowserOps benchmark summaries.
layoutGuidance: Each card must link to both research and product surfaces.

pages.title: MCP Tutorial
pages.purpose: Teach prospects and gated account holders how Monarchic MCP routes connect to client tools, what prerequisites are needed, and how to validate a first workflow.

sections.purpose: Frame the tutorial as a gated-access setup guide for MCP-aware clients.
layoutGuidance: Make the gated-access requirement visible in the first viewport.

sections.purpose: Show the setup sequence, configuration shape, first workflow, and validation boundary.
layoutGuidance: Keep snippets generic and credential-free; explain hosted execution before adapter config; link to product and research pages for product-specific evidence.

pages.title: ExplicitMem Research
pages.purpose: Document ExplicitMem benchmark results, hosted latency smoke data, and the limits of those measurements.

sections.purpose: Present the LongMemEval quality benchmark and hosted MCP latency smoke as separate evidence.
layoutGuidance: Call out the June 26, 2026 hosted staging route scope where latency is used.

sections.purpose: Connect the research back to the ExplicitMem product decision.
layoutGuidance: Do not let product copy replace benchmark methodology.

pages.title: Waitlist
pages.purpose: Provide a dedicated conversion route for gated Monarchic and MCP access.

sections.purpose: Explain what users are joining and why access is gated.
layoutGuidance: Keep the form visible without forcing a long scroll.

sections.purpose: Collect email interest and show visible submit feedback.
layoutGuidance: Preserve the working API-backed waitlist behavior.
